steps.en: Company vehicle owners due for the 3rd reminder are picked for a data check
steps.id: Company pemilik kendaraan yang jatuh tempo reminder ke-3 dipilih untuk dicek datanya
steps.why_en: The check job is switched off in production settings.
steps.why_id: Job pengecekan ini dimatikan di pengaturan produksi.

steps.en: Check runs only when no individual owner, partner or director is found
steps.id: Pengecekan hanya jalan bila tidak ada individu owner, partner atau director yang ditemukan
steps.why_en: No rule looks at whether an individual was found; every company goes through the same check.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada aturan yang melihat apakah individu ditemukan; semua company diproses dengan cara yang sama.

steps.en: The latest company details are requested from the external data source
steps.id: Data terbaru company diminta dari sumber data eksternal
steps.why_en: The source in the system is a government data hub, not clearly the agency named; job is off in production.
steps.why_id: Sumber di sistem adalah data hub pemerintah, belum jelas sama dengan instansi yang disebut; job mati di produksi.

steps.en: The company's latest name replaces the name held on the notice
steps.id: Nama terbaru company menggantikan nama yang tersimpan di notice
steps.why_en: The update logic exists but runs only in a job that is off in production.
steps.why_id: Logic update ada, tetapi hanya di job yang mati di produksi.

steps.en: The company's latest address is saved as the address letters go to
steps.id: Alamat terbaru company disimpan sebagai alamat tujuan surat
steps.why_en: The address update exists but runs only in a job that is off in production.
steps.why_id: Update alamat ada, tetapi hanya di job yang mati di produksi.

steps.en: The 3rd reminder letter to the company uses the refreshed name and address
steps.id: Surat reminder ke-3 ke company memakai nama dan alamat yang sudah diperbarui
steps.why_en: Data is not refreshed in production settings, and sending to the print vendor is blocked.
steps.why_id: Data tidak diperbarui di pengaturan produksi, dan pengiriman ke vendor cetak diblok.
